suggestions: I'm grateful for the git blame that led straight to my own commit from three months ago, so at least I only had myself to be annoyed at.
I'm thankful for the mamak still taking orders past midnight when the deploy went sideways and nobody wanted to go home yet.
I'm grateful for catching the LRT by the width of the closing doors instead of watching it pull away.
I'm thankful for my sister sending voice notes instead of texts, even when they ramble for four minutes about nothing in particular.
I'm grateful for the office playlist landing on a song I actually know the words to, right when the sprint review got tense.
I'm thankful for a code review comment that just said 'nice' instead of the usual wall of nits.
I'm grateful for the quiet hour before the azan when the fridge hum is the loudest thing in the house.
I'm thankful for finding RM50 folded in an old jeans pocket exactly on the week rezeki felt tight.
I'm grateful for a manager who remembered I had a deadline and didn't book a meeting over it anyway.
I'm thankful for teh tarik that's actually tarik-ed properly, not just sweet milk tea pretending.
I'm grateful for the aunty at the warung who still remembers my order without me saying a word.
I'm thankful for a Friday khutbah that actually said something I kept thinking about on the drive home.
I'm grateful for the pull request that merged clean on the first try after a week of conflicts.
I'm thankful for my dad teaching me to check the oil myself instead of just paying someone, even if it took him three tries to explain it.
I'm grateful for the neighbour's cat that waits by my gate like it's been expecting me all day.
